explication: ThingsBoard is an all-in-one IoT platform. Its documented user workflow is to connect devices, collect telemetry, process it with rule chains and calculated fields, raise alarms or notifications, and visualize results in dashboards. The graph preserves those domain stages alongside entity management, querying, and integration event handling. Several implementation links are based on README descriptions rather than sampled call sites; those links cite the README, and unsampled subsystem paths use existing directories from the tree.
